data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 2/5, CRITICAL): cited_excerpt + finding_event_id schema alignment. (a) test_privacy_strip_cited_excerpt: schema requires OMISSION of cited_excerpt key (lines 32, 282) when emit_excerpts=false — NOT null. Change assertion to: jq 'has("cited_excerpt") | not' on POST body. (b) finding_event_id field not in schema; either (i) add additive-optional finding_event_id to schema per additive-fields policy (schema line 24) before this task, OR (ii) reframe --link to populate existing field (e.g., resolver_outcome.finding_id). GREEN task cannot produce schema-valid event that also passes finding_event_id test until resolved.
